George Orwell's real name was **Eric Arthur Blair**.

He was born on June 25, 1903, in Motihari, India (then part of British India), and adopted the pen name "George Orwell" in 1933, which he used for most of his published work, including famous novels like *1984* and *Animal Farm*. He chose "George" as a quintessentially English name and "Orwell" after the River Orwell in Suffolk, England.
